SocialBee vs VEXI: How They Compare in 2026
SocialBee and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Compare SocialBee vs VEXI side-by-side. See pricing, features, and why 1,000+ realtors choose VEXI for done-for-you social media.

SocialBee is an all-in-one social media management tool to create, schedule, publish, analyze and handle your conversations from one dashboard [1]. VEXI makes and posts your social content. They overlap on scheduling, and in many ways they fit together.

SocialBee calls itself an all-in-one social media management tool: you create, schedule, publish, analyze and handle your conversations from a single dashboard [1]. Its AI writes captions, hashtags and images from a prompt, and its AI Assistant builds a social media strategy from your website or business details, with ready-to-edit posts [3]. You can sort posts into content categories, recycle your best evergreen posts and turn new blog articles into posts through RSS [3]. Plans run from Bootstrap at $29 to Pro at $99 a month billed monthly, agency plans start at $179 a month, and there is a 14-day free trial with no credit card [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on scheduling and posting and do different main jobs. Here is what each one does.

SocialBee’s AI writes captions, hashtags and images from a prompt, and its AI Assistant drafts posts by category and platform for you to review, edit and approve; you can import designs from Canva and add photos and GIFs from Unsplash and GIPHY [3].
VEXI does it all for you.

SocialBee publishes Reels, Stories, Shorts and other content types with custom video thumbnails, and its in-house agency, ConciergeBee, has specialists who can manage content creation and video for you [1][2].
VEXI edits your videos for you.
SocialBee’s inbox handles comments, mentions and DMs, and its analytics track audience growth and your top-performing posts, with branded PDF report exports on the Pro plan [1][2].
SocialBee’s Bootstrap, Accelerate and Pro plans cost $29, $49 and $99 a month billed monthly, for 5, 10 and 25 social profiles, and you can add users, workspaces and profiles as add-ons [2].
Monthly or yearly; cancel any time [2]

A fit if you want one dashboard to draft posts with AI, sort them into categories, recycle your evergreen content and schedule it across your networks, with an inbox, analytics and team approvals [1][2][3].
Built for people who want it done right.
Does SocialBee create content for you?

Its AI drafts the posts [3]. SocialBee’s AI writes captions, hashtags and images from a prompt or a URL, and its AI Assistant builds a strategy from your website and generates ready-to-edit posts that you review, edit and approve [3]. SocialBee also runs ConciergeBee, an in-house agency whose specialists can manage content creation, video, community management and ad campaigns for you [2].

SocialBee says its clients range from solo creators to agencies and larger organizations, including freelancers, small businesses and service providers like coaches, doctors, lawyers, realtors, restaurants and hotels [1].
Which networks does SocialBee post to?

SocialBee posts directly to Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube, Google Business Profiles and Bluesky, and its mobile app helps you post to others such as WhatsApp, Telegram and Mastodon [2].

SocialBee’s Bootstrap, Accelerate and Pro plans cost $29, $49 and $99 a month billed monthly, for 5, 10 and 25 social profiles; the agency plans Pro50, Pro100 and Pro150 cost $179, $329 and $449 a month [2]. There is a 14-day free trial with no credit card, and no contracts: you can upgrade, downgrade or cancel at any time [2].
Two different main jobs, with some overlap.
